1.name: Bulbasaur
1.flavor: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.

2.name: Ivysaur
2.flavor: The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs nutrients. The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma when it blooms.

3.name: Venusaur
3.flavor: As it warms it self and absorbs the sunlight, its flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.

4.name: Charmander
4.flavor: If it's healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigor ously, even if it gets a bit wet.

5.name: Charmeleon
5.flavor: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

6.name: Charizard
6.flavor: It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its fire increases as it gains exper ience in battle.

7.name: Squirtle
7.flavor: When it feels threatened, it draws its legs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

8.name: Wartortle
8.flavor: Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, making it quite popular among older people.

9.name: Blastoise
9.flavor: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.

10.name: Caterpie
10.flavor: It crawls into foliage where it camouflages itself among leaves that are the same color as its body.

11.name: Metapod
11.flavor: This is its pre- evolved form. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

12.name: Butterfree
12.flavor: It flits from flower to flower, collecting honey. It can even identify distant flowers in bloom.

13.name: Weedle
13.flavor: The barb on top of its head secretes a strong poison. It uses this toxic barb to protect itself.

14.name: Kakuna
14.flavor: Nearly incapable of movement, it leans against stout trees while waiting for its evolution.

15.name: Beedrill
15.flavor: It uses sharp, poisonous stings to defeat prey, then takes the victim back to its nest for food.

16.name: Pidgey
16.flavor: It rapidly flaps its wings in the grass, stirring up a dust cloud that drives insect prey out into the open.

17.name: Pidgeotto
17.flavor: It slowly flies in a circular pat tern, all the while keeping a sharp lookout for prey.

18.name: Pidgeot
18.flavor: Its outstanding vision allows it to spot splashing MAGIKARP, even while flying at 3300 feet.

19.name: Rattata
19.flavor: This POKéMON's impressive vital ity allows it to live anywhere. It also multiplies very quickly.

20.name: Raticate
20.flavor: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It search es wide areas for food.

21.name: Spearow
21.flavor: To protect its territory, it flies around ceaselessly, making high- pitched cries.

22.name: Fearow
22.flavor: It uses its long beak to attack. It has a surprisingly long reach, so it must be treated with caution.

23.name: Ekans
23.flavor: It flutters the tip of its tongue to seek out the scent of prey, then swallows the prey whole.

24.name: Arbok
24.flavor: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.

25.name: Pikachu
25.flavor: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

26.name: Raichu
26.flavor: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electri city from the atmosphere.

27.name: Sandshrew
27.flavor: It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses the sand to protect itself when threatened.

28.name: Sandslash
28.flavor: Adept at climbing trees, it rolls into a spiny ball, then attacks its enemies from above.

29.name: Nidoran♀
29.flavor: Small and very docile, it pro tects itself with its small, poison ous horn when attacked.

30.name: Nidorina
30.flavor: It has a docile nature. If it is threatened with attack, it raises the barbs that are all over its body.

31.name: Nidoqueen
31.flavor: The hard scales that cover its strong body serve as excellent protection from any attack.

32.name: Nidoran♂
32.flavor: It constantly moves its large ears in many directions in order to detect danger right away.

33.name: Nidorino
33.flavor: It is easily agitated and uses its horn for offense as soon as it notices an attacker.

34.name: Nidoking
34.flavor: It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.

35.name: Clefairy
35.flavor: Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot, for some reason, on the night of a full moon.

36.name: Clefable
36.flavor: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.

37.name: Vulpix
37.flavor: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxur ious coat of fur.

38.name: Ninetales
38.flavor: It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

39.name: Jigglypuff
39.flavor: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.

40.name: Wigglytuff
40.flavor: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.

41.name: Zubat
41.flavor: During the day, it gathers with others and hangs from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.

42.name: Golbat
42.flavor: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.

43.name: Oddish
43.flavor: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bath ing in moonlight.

44.name: Gloom
44.flavor: The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.

45.name: Vileplume
45.flavor: By shaking its big petals, it scat ters toxic pollen into the air, turning the air yellow.

46.name: Paras
46.flavor: The tochukaso growing on this POKéMON's back orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.

47.name: Parasect
47.flavor: When nothing's left to extract from the bug, the mushrooms on its back leave spores on the bug's egg.

48.name: Venonat
48.flavor: The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.

49.name: Venomoth
49.flavor: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

50.name: Diglett
50.flavor: It digs under ground and chews on tree roots, sticking its head out only when the sun isn't bright.

51.name: Dugtrio
51.flavor: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

52.name: Meowth
52.flavor: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.

53.name: Persian
53.flavor: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.

54.name: Psyduck
54.flavor: The only time it can use its psy chic power is when its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.

55.name: Golduck
55.flavor: It swims grace fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

56.name: Mankey
56.flavor: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

57.name: Primeape
57.flavor: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.

58.name: Growlithe
58.flavor: It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.

59.name: Arcanine
59.flavor: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.

60.name: Poliwag
60.flavor: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.

61.name: Poliwhirl
61.flavor: Though it is skilled at walk ing, it prefers to live underwater where there is less danger.

62.name: Poliwrath
62.flavor: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.

63.name: Abra
63.flavor: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.

64.name: Kadabra
64.flavor: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti cles come out of the surface of its body.

65.name: Alakazam
65.flavor: It has an IQ of 5000. It calcu lates many things in order to gain the edge in every battle.

66.name: Machop
66.flavor: It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.

67.name: Machoke
67.flavor: This tough POKéMON always stays in the zone. Its muscles become thicker after every battle.

68.name: Machamp
68.flavor: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

69.name: Bellsprout
69.flavor: If it notices anything that moves, it immediately flings its vine at the object.

70.name: Weepinbell
70.flavor: When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.

71.name: Victreebel
71.flavor: Once ingested into this POKéMON's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

72.name: Tentacool
72.flavor: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.

73.name: Tentacruel
73.flavor: When its 80 feel ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.

74.name: Geodude
74.flavor: Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.

75.name: Graveler
75.flavor: It travels by rol ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.

76.name: Golem
76.flavor: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.

77.name: Ponyta
77.flavor: Training by jumping over grass that grows longer every day has made it a world-class jumper.

78.name: Rapidash
78.flavor: It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the long er the swaying flames of its mane will become.

79.name: Slowpoke
79.flavor: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.

80.name: Slowbro
80.flavor: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.

81.name: Magnemite
81.flavor: The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.

82.name: Magneton
82.flavor: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.

83.name: Farfetch’d
83.flavor: In order to pre vent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these POKéMON.

84.name: Doduo
84.flavor: It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.

85.name: Dodrio
85.flavor: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.

86.name: Seel
86.flavor: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves iceberg- filled oceans.

87.name: Dewgong
87.flavor: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.

88.name: Grimer
88.flavor: When two of these POKéMON's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

89.name: Muk
89.flavor: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.

90.name: Shellder
90.flavor: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

91.name: Cloyster
91.flavor: Even a missile can't break the spikes it uses to stab opponents. They're even hard er than its shell.

92.name: Gastly
92.flavor: It wraps its op ponent in its gas- like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

93.name: Haunter
93.flavor: It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of the next living thing that wanders close by.

94.name: Gengar
94.flavor: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

95.name: Onix
95.flavor: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

96.name: Drowzee
96.flavor: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

97.name: Hypno
97.flavor: The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.

98.name: Krabby
98.flavor: If it is unable to find food, it will absorb nutrients by swallowing a mouthful of sand.

99.name: Kingler
99.flavor: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

100.name: Voltorb
100.flavor: During the study of this POKéMON, it was discovered that its compo nents are not found in nature.

101.name: Electrode
101.flavor: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

102.name: Exeggcute
102.flavor: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.

103.name: Exeggutor
103.flavor: Living in a good environment makes it grow lots of heads. A head that drops off becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

104.name: Cubone
104.flavor: It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its mother's skull, never revealing its true face.

105.name: Marowak
105.flavor: Somewhere in the world is a ceme tery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.

106.name: Hitmonlee
106.flavor: It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.

107.name: Hitmonchan
107.flavor: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.

108.name: Lickitung
108.flavor: It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.

109.name: Koffing
109.flavor: If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.

110.name: Weezing
110.flavor: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

111.name: Rhyhorn
111.flavor: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

112.name: Rhydon
112.flavor: By lightly spin ning its drill- like horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.

113.name: Chansey
113.flavor: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.

114.name: Tangela
114.flavor: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.

115.name: Kangaskhan
115.flavor: To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.

116.name: Horsea
116.flavor: When they're in a safe location, they can be seen playfully tangling their tails together.

117.name: Seadra
117.flavor: The male raises the young. If it is approached, it uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.

118.name: Goldeen
118.flavor: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.

119.name: Seaking
119.flavor: When autumn comes, the males patrol the area around their nests in order to protect their offspring.

120.name: Staryu
120.flavor: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.

121.name: Starmie
121.flavor: It is said that it uses the seven- colored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.

122.name: Mr. Mime
122.flavor: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.

123.name: Scyther
123.flavor: It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.

124.name: Jynx
124.flavor: It has several different cry pat terns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.

125.name: Electabuzz
125.flavor: When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the electric currents to communicate their feelings.

126.name: Magmar
126.flavor: It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal itself by dipping its wound into lava.

127.name: Pinsir
127.flavor: When the tempera ture drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.

128.name: Tauros
128.flavor: These violent POKéMON fight with other mem bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.

129.name: Magikarp
129.flavor: This weak and pathetic POKéMON gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.

130.name: Gyarados
130.flavor: It appears when ever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through.

131.name: Lapras
131.flavor: This gentle POKéMON loves to give people rides and provides a ve ry comfortable way to get around.

132.name: Ditto
132.flavor: When it encount ers another DITTO, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

133.name: Eevee
133.flavor: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

134.name: Vaporeon
134.flavor: As it uses the fins on the tip of its tail to swim, it blends with the water perfectly.

135.name: Jolteon
135.flavor: The negatively charged ions generated in its fur create a constant sparking noise.

136.name: Flareon
136.flavor: Once it has stored up enough heat, this POKéMON's body temperature can reach up to 1700 degrees.

137.name: Porygon
137.flavor: An artificial POKéMON created due to extensive research, it can perform only what is in its program.

138.name: Omanyte
138.flavor: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.

139.name: Omastar
139.flavor: Its heavy shell allowed it to reach only nearby food. This could be the reason it is extinct.

140.name: Kabuto
140.flavor: Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.

141.name: Kabutops
141.flavor: It was able to swim quickly thro ugh the water by compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.

142.name: Aerodactyl
142.flavor: In prehistoric times, this POKéMON flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.

143.name: Snorlax
143.flavor: This POKéMON's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

144.name: Articuno
144.flavor: Legendary bird POKéMON. As it flies through the sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.

145.name: Zapdos
145.flavor: Legendary bird POKéMON. They say lightning caused by the flapping of its wings causes summer storms.

146.name: Moltres
146.flavor: Legendary bird POKéMON. It is said to migrate from the south along with the spring.

147.name: Dratini
147.flavor: It sheds many lay ers of skin as it grows larger. Dur ing this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

148.name: Dragonair
148.flavor: It is called the divine POKéMON. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

149.name: Dragonite
149.flavor: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

150.name: Mewtwo
150.flavor: Said to rest qui etly in an undiscovered cave, this POKéMON was created solely for battling.

151.name: Mew
151.flavor: Because it can learn any move, some people began research to see if it is the ancestor of all POKéMON.

152.name: Chikorita
152.flavor: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

153.name: Bayleef
153.flavor: The scent that wafts from the leaves on its neck causes anyone who smells it to become energetic.

154.name: Meganium
154.flavor: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were relaxing in a sunny forest.

155.name: Cyndaquil
155.flavor: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

156.name: Quilava
156.flavor: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

157.name: Typhlosion
157.flavor: When heat from its body causes the air around it to shimmer, this is a sign that it is ready to battle.

158.name: Totodile
158.flavor: This rough critter chomps at any moving object it sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.

159.name: Croconaw
159.flavor: The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.

160.name: Feraligatr
160.flavor: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.

161.name: Sentret
161.flavor: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

162.name: Furret
162.flavor: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more maze like they become.

163.name: Hoothoot
163.flavor: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.

164.name: Noctowl
164.flavor: Its extremely soft feathers make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.

165.name: Ledyba
165.flavor: It is timid and clusters together with others. The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.

166.name: Ledian
166.flavor: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.

167.name: Spinarak
167.flavor: If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.

168.name: Ariados
168.flavor: Rather than mak ing a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls.

169.name: Crobat
169.flavor: As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.

170.name: Chinchou
170.flavor: Its antennae, whi ch evolved from a fin, have both po sitive and neg ative charges flo wing through them.

171.name: Lanturn
171.flavor: This POKéMON uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.

172.name: Pichu
172.flavor: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

173.name: Cleffa
173.flavor: If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this POKéMON is certain to be within the immediate area.

174.name: Igglybuff
174.flavor: Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.

175.name: Togepi
175.flavor: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

176.name: Togetic
176.flavor: Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.

177.name: Natu
177.flavor: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

178.name: Xatu
178.flavor: Once it begins to meditate at sun rise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.

179.name: Mareep
179.flavor: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

180.name: Flaaffy
180.flavor: Because of its rubbery, electric ity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electric ity in its fur.

181.name: Ampharos
181.flavor: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.

182.name: Bellossom
182.flavor: When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.

183.name: Marill
183.flavor: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

184.name: Azumarill
184.flavor: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

185.name: Sudowoodo
185.flavor: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

186.name: Politoed
186.flavor: When it expands its throat to croak out a tune, nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.

187.name: Hoppip
187.flavor: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.

188.name: Skiploom
188.flavor: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.

189.name: Jumpluff
189.flavor: Even in the fierc est wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

190.name: Aipom
190.flavor: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.

191.name: Sunkern
191.flavor: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

192.name: Sunflora
192.flavor: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this POKéMON's face become more vivid and lively.

193.name: Yanma
193.flavor: It can see in all directions without moving its big eyes, helping it spot attackers and food right away.

194.name: Wooper
194.flavor: A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.

195.name: Quagsire
195.flavor: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

196.name: Espeon
196.flavor: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

197.name: Umbreon
197.flavor: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

198.name: Murkrow
198.flavor: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.

199.name: Slowking
199.flavor: Every time it ya wns, SHELLDER injects more poi son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.

200.name: Misdreavus
200.flavor: It loves to watch people it's scar ed. It frightens them by screaming loudly or appear ing suddenly.

201.name: Unown
201.flavor: Because different types of UNOWN exist, it is said that they must have a variety of abilities.

202.name: Wobbuffet
202.flavor: In order to con ceal its black tail, it lives in a dark cave and only moves about at night.

203.name: Girafarig
203.flavor: When it is in danger, its tail uses some sort of mysterious powers to drive away the enemy.

204.name: Pineco
204.flavor: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

205.name: Forretress
205.flavor: Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

206.name: Dunsparce
206.flavor: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.

207.name: Gligar
207.flavor: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

208.name: Steelix
208.flavor: The many small metal particles that cover this POKéMON's body reflect bright light well.

209.name: Snubbull
209.flavor: In truth, it is a cowardly POKéMON. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

210.name: Granbull
210.flavor: It can make most any POKéMON run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

211.name: Qwilfish
211.flavor: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.

212.name: Scizor
212.flavor: This POKéMON's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.

213.name: Shuckle
213.flavor: The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.

214.name: Heracross
214.flavor: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.

215.name: Sneasel
215.flavor: This cunning POKéMON hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

216.name: Teddiursa
216.flavor: It always licks honey. Its palm tastes sweet because of all the honey it has absorbed.

217.name: Ursaring
217.flavor: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

218.name: Slugma
218.flavor: These group to gether in areas that are hotter than normal. If it cools off, its skin hardens.

219.name: Magcargo
219.flavor: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

220.name: Swinub
220.flavor: It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.

221.name: Piloswine
221.flavor: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

222.name: Corsola
222.flavor: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.

223.name: Remoraid
223.flavor: To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.

224.name: Octillery
224.flavor: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

225.name: Delibird
225.flavor: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

226.name: Mantine
226.flavor: It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.

227.name: Skarmory
227.flavor: The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said that people once used the feathers as swords.

228.name: Houndour
228.flavor: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

229.name: Houndoom
229.flavor: The pungent- smelling flame that shoots from its mouth results from toxins burn ing in its body.

230.name: Kingdra
230.flavor: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

231.name: Phanpy
231.flavor: During the desert ed morning hours, it comes ashore where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.

232.name: Donphan
232.flavor: Because this POKéMON's skin is so tough, a normal attack won't even leave a scratch on it.

233.name: Porygon2
233.flavor: This manmade POKéMON evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprog rammed reactions.

234.name: Stantler
234.flavor: The round balls found on the fallen antlers can be ground into a powder that aids in sleeping.

235.name: Smeargle
235.flavor: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its tail is predeter mined for each SMEARGLE.

236.name: Tyrogue
236.flavor: To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge anyone. It has a very strong com petitive spirit.

237.name: Hitmontop
237.flavor: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

238.name: Smoochum
238.flavor: The sensitivity of its lips develops most quickly. It uses them to try to identify unknown objects.

239.name: Elekid
239.flavor: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish- white when it is charging energy.

240.name: Magby
240.flavor: It naturally spits an 1100-degree flame. It is said when many appear, it heralds a volcanic eruption.

241.name: Miltank
241.flavor: In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for rhythmically pull ing up and down on its udders.

242.name: Blissey
242.flavor: Biting into one of the delicious eggs that BLISSEY provides will make everyone around smile with joy.

243.name: Raikou
243.flavor: This rough POKéMON stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

244.name: Entei
244.flavor: This brawny POKéMON courses around the earth, spouting flames hotter than a volcano's magma.

245.name: Suicune
245.flavor: This divine POKéMON blows around the world, always in search of a pure reservoir.

246.name: Larvitar
246.flavor: Born deep under ground, this POKéMON becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

247.name: Pupitar
247.flavor: It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

248.name: Tyranitar
248.flavor: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and moun tains crumble.

249.name: Lugia
249.flavor: It has an incred ible ability to calm raging sto rms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.

250.name: Ho-Oh
250.flavor: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted trainer by shining its bright rain bow-colored wings.

251.name: Celebi
251.flavor: Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI appears wherever beautiful forests exist.
